name: Yamaha XS750 Triple
engine: 747 cc air-cooled DOHC inline triple, three Mikuni carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's shaft-drive triple. Known for second gear trouble and fussy vacuum petcocks.

add.title: Test second gear under load
add.instructions: On a test ride, load the bike hard in second gear. If it pops out, the shift forks or gear dogs are worn and the cases need to come apart.
add.reason: Second gear failure is the best-known XS750 fault.

G: Check the vacuum petcocks. A leaking diaphragm can flood the carbs or pull fuel into the engine.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Second gear
known.what: Second gear can pop out, often fixed by shimming or new parts.
